minimum_rule: Requires >=2 broad epithelial markers and no strong immune/stromal/endothelial marker conflict. Do not infer malignancy from epithelial markers alone.
note: Use for broad epithelial extraction before malignancy analysis.

minimum_rule: Subtype/state annotation within epithelial cells; requires epithelial background plus both pit/mucous markers when possible.
note: Do not use as broad epithelial or malignant marker.

minimum_rule: Subtype/state annotation within epithelial cells; requires epithelial background plus neck/mucous markers.
note: Validate against dataset-specific epithelial cluster markers.

minimum_rule: Subtype annotation within epithelial cells; requires epithelial background and chief-cell digestive enzyme markers.
note: Chief markers may be sparse in tumor datasets.

minimum_rule: Subtype/state annotation within epithelial cells; requires epithelial background and intestinal-like markers.
note: May indicate intestinal metaplasia-like or tumor state depending on sample source.

minimum_rule: Subtype annotation within epithelial cells; requires endocrine markers and epithelial context.
note: Rare population; check cell number before assigning cluster label.

minimum_rule: Requires pan-T markers CD3D/CD3E/CD3G; CD8A defines subtype/state only after pan-T identity is clear.
note: Separate cytotoxic T from NK by pan-T marker positivity.

minimum_rule: Subtype annotation within T cells; requires T-cell background plus FOXP3 and IL2RA/CD25 evidence.
note: Do not annotate broad clusters as Treg from IL2RA alone.

minimum_rule: Requires cytotoxic/NK markers with absent or low pan-T markers; distinguish from cytotoxic T cells.
note: NKG7/GNLY can mark cytotoxic T cells, so pan-T negativity matters.

minimum_rule: Requires B-cell markers; distinguish from plasma cells by low MZB1/IGKC/DERL3 dominance.
note: MS4A1 may be low in some B-cell states.

minimum_rule: Requires plasma/immunoglobulin program; check ambient RNA if immunoglobulin genes appear broadly.
note: Do not merge plasma cells into B cells without checking MZB1/IGKC/DERL3.

minimum_rule: Broad myeloid label requires multiple myeloid-associated genes; subcluster into monocyte/macrophage/DC where possible.
note: Coarse lineage label only; do not use one myeloid marker to make final subtype calls.

minimum_rule: Requires broad myeloid background plus VCAN/LYZ/CD14 monocyte-like marker pattern; avoid over-subtyping if cluster is small.
note: Use as monocyte-like annotation, then inspect macrophage/DC markers.

minimum_rule: Requires broad myeloid background plus macrophage/TAM-associated markers.
note: Macrophage states can overlap with monocytes; verify with cluster markers.

minimum_rule: DC annotation requires myeloid/APC context plus subtype-specific DC markers; split cDC/mature DC only if supported by markers and cell counts.
note: Broad DC is a convenience label; do not merge mutually exclusive DC subtypes without checking cluster markers.

minimum_rule: Requires mast-cell protease markers; check for small but distinct cluster.
note: Usually a distinct cluster if present.

minimum_rule: Requires extracellular matrix/stromal markers and absence of epithelial/immune/endothelial marker conflict.
note: CAF can be annotated as fibroblast first, then subtype if supported.

minimum_rule: CAF annotation requires fibroblast background plus at least two activation/CAF-associated markers; FAP alone is insufficient.
note: Use cautiously; CAF is heterogeneous and subtype labels need separate analysis.

minimum_rule: Requires multiple endothelial markers and absence of epithelial/immune/fibroblast marker conflict.
note: Can split vascular/lymphatic only if markers support it.

minimum_rule: Requires a perivascular marker pattern; RGS5 alone is insufficient and smooth muscle markers should be checked in parallel.
note: May overlap with smooth muscle/stromal cells; keep uncertain cases as perivascular_stromal_uncertain.

minimum_rule: Requires smooth muscle contractile markers; distinguish from myofibroblast/CAF by MYH11/ACTA2/TAGLN pattern.
note: ACTA2 alone is not specific.

minimum_rule: Cell-cycle state label only; must be combined with lineage identity and should not replace cell type annotation.
note: Use as state annotation, not lineage.
